title: PSGC — Barangays in the City of Dagupan (0105518000)
notes: Release date 13 July 2026, announced as "Second Quarter 2026 PSGC Updates". The dataset itself is stated as "Philippine Standard Geographic Code as of 30 June 2026", which is why the release date and the reference date are recorded separately. The page separately states "There are 31 barangays as of 31 July 2025"; that is a third date and applies to the count, not to the codes or population figures. Authoritative for the current barangay names, PSGC codes, urban/rural classification and 2024 POPCEN population. The equivalent bulk file is PSGC-2Q-2026-Publication-Datafile.xlsx.
